stories.headline: Bosch guided 'flattish' growth in May, Q1 revenue rose 22% instead
stories.instagram_caption:
Bosch Limited guided flattish growth for the quarter back in May.
Actual Q1: revenue up 22% YoY, EBITDA up 28% YoY, margins improved to 14%.
Power Solutions outperformed the market across segments; Aftermarket rebounded to 9.6% growth.
Management now guides 8% growth for the next quarter.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.
stories.youtube_shorts_script:
[ON-SCREEN: BOSCH LIMITED - Q1 FY27]
In May, Bosch management guided flattish growth for the quarter.
[ON-SCREEN: GUIDANCE: FLATTISH]
The actual Q1 numbers came in well above that.
[ON-SCREEN: REVENUE +22% YoY | EBITDA +28% YoY]
Revenue grew 22% year-on-year, EBITDA grew 28%, and margins improved to 14%.
[ON-SCREEN: MARGIN: 14%]
Power Solutions outperformed the market across segments, and Aftermarket sales rebounded to 9.6% growth.
Management is now guiding 8% growth for the next quarter.
[ON-SCREEN: NEXT QTR GUIDE: 8% GROWTH]
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.

stories.headline: Godawari Power Q1 EBITDA margin at 19.1%, well below 24-25% FY27 guidance
stories.instagram_caption:
Godawari Power And Ispat had guided a 24-25% EBITDA margin for FY27.
Q1 came in at 19.1%, pressured by input cost spikes after the West Asia crisis.
The integrated steel plant has been moved to abeyance indefinitely.
CRM relocation delayed to December 2027 (from March 2027); capex raised to Rs.1,100 crores.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.
stories.youtube_shorts_script:
[ON-SCREEN: GODAWARI POWER AND ISPAT - Q1 FY27]
Godawari Power had guided a 24 to 25% EBITDA margin for FY27.
[ON-SCREEN: FY27 GUIDANCE: 24-25%]
Q1 actual margin came in at just 19.1%, hit by input cost spikes after the West Asia crisis.
[ON-SCREEN: Q1 ACTUAL: 19.1%]
Management also disclosed the integrated steel plant has been moved to abeyance indefinitely.
The CRM relocation has been delayed to December 2027, pushed from March 2027, with capex raised to Rs.1,100 crores.
[ON-SCREEN: CRM DELAYED TO DEC 2027]
Pellet production guidance was also revised lower, and one plant was shut due to gas pricing.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.

stories.headline: Blue Star's UCP segment margin fell to 2.9% vs 8-8.5% target; guidance cut to 6.5%
stories.instagram_caption:
Blue Star had targeted an 8-8.5% EBIT margin for its Segment II (UCP) business.
Q1 actual margin came in at just 2.9%, after only 5% of a warranted 13% price hike was passed on.
FY27 UCP margin guidance has now been revised down to a 6.5% minimum.
Data center MEP remained strong: Rs.1,500 crore of Q1 inflow, targeting Rs.3,000 crore annually.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.
stories.youtube_shorts_script:
[ON-SCREEN: BLUE STAR LIMITED - Q1 FY27]
Blue Star had targeted an 8 to 8.5% EBIT margin for its UCP segment.
[ON-SCREEN: SEGMENT II TARGET: 8-8.5%]
Q1 actual margin came in at just 2.9%.
[ON-SCREEN: Q1 ACTUAL: 2.9%]
Management said only 5% of a warranted 13% price increase was actually passed on, and heavy promotional spend was needed due to a late summer.
FY27 UCP margin guidance has now been revised down to a 6.5% minimum, from the earlier 8 to 8.5%.
[ON-SCREEN: FY27 GUIDANCE CUT TO 6.5%]
One bright spot: data center MEP orders stayed strong, with Rs.1,500 crore of Q1 inflow and a Rs.3,000 crore annual target.
Management expects recovery from Q3 onward.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.

stories.headline: CMS Info cut its FY27 revenue guidance while raising its margin guidance
stories.instagram_caption:
CMS Info Systems lowered its FY27 services revenue guidance to Rs.2,650-2,750 crores, from Rs.2,700-2,800 crores.
In the same breath, EBITDA margin guidance was raised to 27%, from 25-26%.
Q1 services revenue hit a record Rs.625 crores but fell short of the Rs.650 crore internal target, attributed to a worst-in-decade currency supply crunch.
Margin still expanded 170 bps sequentially.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.
stories.youtube_shorts_script:
[ON-SCREEN: CMS INFO SYSTEMS - Q1 FY27]
CMS Info Systems moved two guidance numbers in opposite directions on the same call.
FY27 services revenue guidance was lowered, to Rs.2,650 to 2,750 crores from Rs.2,700 to 2,800 crores.
[ON-SCREEN: REVENUE GUIDANCE: CUT]
But EBITDA margin guidance was raised, to 27% from 25 to 26%.
[ON-SCREEN: MARGIN GUIDANCE: RAISED TO 27%]
Q1 services revenue hit a record Rs.625 crores, but still missed the company's own Rs.650 crore target, which management attributed to a worst-in-decade currency supply crunch.
Margin still expanded 170 basis points sequentially.
[ON-SCREEN: Q1 SERVICES REVENUE: RS.625 CR]
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.

stories.headline: Speciality Restaurants declined to repeat its Rs.600 crore FY27 revenue target
stories.instagram_caption:
Speciality Restaurants had previously guided a Rs.600 crore FY27 revenue target.
On this call, management declined to repeat that number, citing only that the company is 'working hard' and pointing to a Q3 opportunity.
Q1 same-store-sales growth came in at 11.35%, up from 2.25% in Q4.
Gross margin expanded to 71.1%.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.
stories.youtube_shorts_script:
[ON-SCREEN: SPECIALITY RESTAURANTS - Q1 FY27]
Speciality Restaurants had previously guided a Rs.600 crore revenue target for FY27.
[ON-SCREEN: PRIOR TARGET: RS.600 CR FY27]
On this call, when asked, management did not repeat that number.
The response stayed vague, citing only that the company is 'working hard' and pointing to an opportunity in Q3.
[ON-SCREEN: TARGET NOT REPEATED]
Meanwhile, the actual Q1 numbers were strong: same-store-sales growth hit 11.35%, up sharply from 2.25% in Q4.
[ON-SCREEN: Q1 SSSG: 11.35%]
Gross margin expanded to 71.1%.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.
